Gold and Silver Prices Decline Amid Global Market Shifts

Gold prices have fallen below Rs 1.53 lakh, with silver experiencing a drop of nearly Rs 3,000. This decline follows a period of significant gains, with gold prices having risen 9% in August and remaining elevated by 59% year-on-year. Factors influencing the market include easing US Federal Reserve rate hike expectations, a weaker dollar, and global tensions. Despite recent moderation, gold is seen by some as a potential key pillar of India's growth story.
